I am an Assistant Professor at the [Department of Geology at Lakehead University](https://www.lakeheadu.ca/programs/departments/geology) in Thunder Bay (Canada). I received a PhD in geology from Technische Universität Bergakademie Freiberg (Germany) in 2019.


My research addresses how the continental lithosphere deforms across scales and through time, and how that deformation records, and in turn controls the migration of crustal fluids and the localization of strain and mineralization. The work combines classical, field-based structural geology with modern mathematical and statistical methods and incorporates techniques from metamorphic petrology, crystallographic preferred orientation, geophysics, geochemistry, geo-thermochronology, and provenance analysis.

I teach courses on structural geology, tectonics, metamorphic petrology, and data science for geology.
